description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for a proposed method versus several LLM models in a streaming setting. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, shown left to right as: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude, with labels angled; there is no explicit x-axis label. The vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks every 50 seconds, with light dashed horizontal gridlines. There are five single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Our Joint Framework” is a dark green bar with an annotated value of 77; the remaining four bars are light blue (legend-labeled “LLM Models”) with annotated values of 190 for ChatGPT, 365 for DeepSeek, 172 for LLaMA, and approximately 243 for Claude (the Claude bar has no visible numeric annotation but reaches just below the 250-second tick). The bars are not presented in a clearly sorted order (neither strictly ascending nor descending), and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the value labels above most bars.
